# Kit Protocol: 07 Review

Source contract extracted from the Build Spec agent-contracts section. Portable SoT for this stage.

Output: review artifact from `_ask/templates/review.md`.

## 15.7 07 Review Agent

Purpose:

```text
Independently inspect implementation against the accepted specification and project policy.
```

Must produce structured findings.

It should prefer evidence and concrete locations over generic criticism.

A review agent is not the sole acceptance mechanism.

---

## Kit path

See `_ask/policies/workflow.md`. Prepare `review.md`. After defaults-OK, do not require a separate bless of the review file; Accept is the second confirm. Off-path only if they explicitly leave the kit.

## Model spawn (required)

Spawn the generated Review subagent for the current runtime. Present the model picker as selectable choices (default is resolved cheap/diverse pool for workstream risk; unset risk is LOW → cheap). A highlight alone is not consent. If the selected model is the same family as Implement, explain why and offer “Continue with this model” / “Choose another model” as choices; proceed only on the submitted continue choice. If buttons are unavailable, offer numbered choices and accept the number or option label, never a written confirmation sentence. Record model, runtime, and parent_model on review.md. Do not author the review only in the parent context.

## Inner-loop

When `work/<work-id>/inner-loop/tasks.yaml` exists, review the **current** writer only (`./ask inner-loop status`).

Use the classification and completion rules in `.agents/ask/task-loop.md`.
Report local structural suggestions, broader horizontal refactors, existing-spec
behavior defects, required redesign, and evidence-backed withdrawals separately.

**Steering boundary:** run `git diff --name-only` and match those paths to the task’s `owned_paths` globs (seam/module patterns, not a file list). Verdict is `APPROVED` or `REJECTED`.

- Outside glob and not required → extras; revert; one remediation.
- Required path outside the glob → `glob_too_narrow`; blocked.

Review commits nothing. Scratch writes are allowed. Write an attributable review artifact for the exact candidate and report verdict/boundary to the coordinator. The coordinator uses `./ask inner-loop record-review` to bind that decision to the TaskResult and review bytes; see `_ask/docs/inner-loop-evidence.md`. A worker-supplied acknowledgment alone cannot authorize integration.

## Structured test evidence

Independently review every criterion/type and test assertion, counterexample, changed-test inventory and TDD continuity. The coordinator records the candidate-bound decision with `./ask traceability record-review`.

Contract, authority, commands and migration: `_ask/docs/spec-test-traceability.md`.
